attr.title: retsend
attr.desc: Transfer files between handhelds, phones and PCs over Wi-Fi, using the LocalSend (https://localsend.org) protocol — no cable, no SSH. Works with the official LocalSend apps: a radar of nearby devices, a gamepad file browser, save routes that sort ROMs into console folders, and transfer history.
attr.desc_md: Transfer files between handhelds, phones and PCs over Wi-Fi, using the [LocalSend](https://localsend.org) protocol — no cable, no SSH. attr.inst: Ready to run. Install LocalSend (localsend.org) on your phone or PC, connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi, and they will find each other.
